Tommy Peoples / Key

I got this tune years ago from Desi Wilkinson. He called it “Tommy Peoples‘ ” jig, but that’s maybe just because it was learned from him. I haven’t posted it with that name otherwise it’ll turn up in about a dozen recordings when it ’s a different tune altogether. Recorded also by that fine Belfast band “Craobh Rua”.

Keys to the Convent

This jig is also one of four tunes with the title “King of the Pipers.” An excellent fiddle version (by Gerry O‘Connor) can be heard on the album “Bridhid’s Kiss” by fiddler Gerry O’Connor & fluter/vocalist Eithne N

The title ‘Tommy Peoples’ does belong to this jig too, if only because that is the title under which it appeared in the 1974 Bulmer and Sharpley “Music of Ireland” books (book 3, tune 70).
